
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/22974770" title="发布于 2026-09-15 06:24">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Linux 日志神器 journalctl 完全指南：彻底替代传统日志查看方式</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-page-id="EXtIdz4Opo2yjpxCLhIcQqFZnTc" data-lark-html-role="root" data-docx-has-block-data="true">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-EXtIdz4Opo2yjpxCLhIcQqFZnTc">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ZcgOfUsujdXfGNcxukXcosVxnpf">在 CentOS 7+、Ubuntu 16.04+ 现代 Linux 系统中，<code>systemd</code> 接管了系统和服务的所有管理工作，同时带来了全新的日志管理工具 <strong>journalctl</strong>。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DqcafxkcVd51fFcvmTmcHFmgn2b">以往我们排查问题，需要挨个查看<code>/var/log/messages</code>、<code>/var/log/nginx</code>、<code>/var/log/secure</code> 等零散日志文件，杂乱且低效。而 <strong>journalctl 统一收集系统、内核、所有服务、程序的日志</strong>，支持精准过滤、时间回溯、实时监控、日志归档，是运维、后端开发排查服务器问题的必备神器。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IaQYfqgyudgy1ZcqoDQcTM9bn6e">本文整理 <strong>零基础入门 → 高频实操 → 生产场景 → 日志清理优化</strong> 全套用法，看完直接告别传统日志排查方式。</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-FCOdfkC7Ndae0scCE6QcvKTDnhe">一、journalctl 是什么？核心优势</h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-EpPFfcvxRdVoExcD5ClcFJrbnEd">1. 工作原理</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LhpgfaqLtdm96IcXfQecWFSNnzg"><code>journalctl</code> 是 systemd 配套的日志查看工具，系统所有组件的日志都会统一写入 <code>/var/log/journal/</code> 二进制日志文件，不再散落各处。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ActGfc3lQdFADtcPwmxclDm5nwg">区别于传统文本日志，它存储的是<strong>结构化二进制日志</strong>，自带元数据（服务名、进程ID、用户ID、日志级别、时间戳），支持精准筛选，效率远超 grep 文本检索。</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-YuY7fybZQdBQl1cVWVbcg8DSnWe">2. 核心优势</h3>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MtfRf5wY1dmXdzckHVAcmGARnNb" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>统一管理</strong>：系统日志、内核日志、所有自定义服务日志全部整合</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Y2wLfK9qndVwX5cDolFck0z8nRh" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>精准过滤</strong>：按服务、时间、日志级别、进程、用户精准筛选</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-M9nLfzgaqdh5hmcYo1UcbRT2n6d" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>开机回溯</strong>：可查看历史开机的日志，排查开机启动故障</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-M711fVeA5daqYYcyaIWcc0pXnCh" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>实时监控</strong>：类似 tail -f，实时输出最新日志</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CyMcfh4CsdtsEjcgt1ycbdF4nhh" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>自动归档</strong>：支持限制日志大小、过期自动清理，避免磁盘爆满</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Mt3JfOjcSda5o5c7C5lcLX12nWc">二、基础入门：最简单的查看命令</h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-ZFZAf0rbcd6ke4cuMtCcD67YnHh">1. 查看全部系统日志</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Hh4ifxyLKdByZ1cZALQc31v1nzc">直接执行命令，输出系统所有日志，按时间正序展示（旧日志在前，新日志在后）：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-XVrLfe0BtdII3vchLKlc5ItBnhf highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div>journalctl</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-XVrLfe0BtdII3vchLKlc5ItBnhf highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TRXSf6Yggd11Njc4agOcWb0Onjd">默认进入分页模式，操作快捷键：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LN6YfaA6kdPOuacKthIcdUQGnBe" data-list="bullet">
<div>空格：翻页</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HVmaf4vzadJrm5cfyvLc34Yrn4g" data-list="bullet">
<div>回车：逐行下滑</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Q990fYcQLdBVEacNIHycEyj5n9c" data-list="bullet">
<div>q：退出查看</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-TkpUfHOindhj7RcduRvc3BcGnPf">2. 倒序查看（最新日志在前）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FCngfkKu9dVM6HcvkVfclFGmnSh">默认日志从旧到新，排查问题不方便，<code>-r</code> 参数反向输出，最新日志优先展示：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-V8XyfrW52dP7gwcwXfOcfVppnfe highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div>journalctl -r</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-V8XyfrW52dP7gwcwXfOcfVppnfe highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-XrTOfElGpdCSfvcMFy5cXzFonzf">3. 查看最近 N 行日志</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OKHafadMHdLrR1cniwfcbMjDnce">等价于 tail 命令，快速查看最新日志：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-SyMEfLel5duOU1c4f3ccnaEknac highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 查看最后100行日志 journalctl -n 100 # 默认查看最后10行 journalctl -n</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-SyMEfLel5duOU1c4f3ccnaEknac highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-XPWzfQ1O5dkDeCcHPuacgz9Vndg">4. 实时监控日志（高频常用）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GNxKfjRd3dvx3ncvjgkc59dDnTe">等价于 <code>tail -f</code>，实时刷新最新日志，适合动态排查服务报错：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-LxLJfSNDrdO01Zcb5mbccxdVnad highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div>journalctl -f</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-LxLJfSNDrdO01Zcb5mbccxdVnad highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-RM8wfoOZedUMiUcPOD7c7EpFn3e">三、核心进阶：精准过滤日志（生产必备）</h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-SiVLfgglzdJYJYciOjwceJysn14">1. 按服务筛选日志（最常用）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JN3Rf0jmtdozRPczwryciZIgnJe">通过 <code>-u</code> 参数指定 systemd 服务，只查看对应服务日志，精准定位问题。支持 Nginx、MySQL、SSH、自定义后台服务等。</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-L55rfzojudQHxccVq1QcnzOknqc highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 查看 nginx 服务全部日志 journalctl -u nginx.service # 查看 ssh 服务实时日志 journalctl -u sshd.service -f # 同时查看多个服务日志 journalctl -u nginx -u mysql</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-L55rfzojudQHxccVq1QcnzOknqc highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AliMfmv3gdcZ5gcsThac8XfFn9c">💡 搭配 <code>systemctl status 服务名</code>，先看服务状态，再用 journalctl 查详细报错，是排查服务异常的标准流程。</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-LXogf7KSgdIsEFciXMec6fKOnmf">2. 按时间范围筛选</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PQhnfA1YadFW0LcliXRcK2iDnWe">支持人性化时间语法，无需计算时间戳，灵活筛选指定时段日志：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-NDgifqBuqdI60Ic7LKsce8hbnlb highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 查看今天所有日志 journalctl --since today # 查看最近1小时日志 journalctl --since "1 hour ago" # 查看昨天的日志 journalctl --since yesterday --until today # 指定精确时间范围 journalctl --since "2026-09-01 10:00:00" --until "2026-09-01 12:00:00"</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-NDgifqBuqdI60Ic7LKsce8hbnlb highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-NRyqfnvVbdjeM1cT9mXcZ1w9nPc">3. 按日志级别筛选（只看报错）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RV1efSDX1dSuFLcgmF0cGnmZnxc">通过 <code>-p</code> 参数过滤日志等级，排查问题时直接过滤无效信息，只看错误、警告日志。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ALYpfbwR1dhJtXcxaxtcHDiTnYd">日志级别优先级（从低到高）：<code>debug &lt; info &lt; notice &lt; warning &lt; err &lt; crit &lt; alert &lt; emerg</code></div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-VZHBfG7L6dNZyvc3HhbckEUFnzf highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 只查看错误及以上级别日志（生产排查首选） journalctl -p err # 查看警告、错误日志 journalctl -p warning # 结合服务+时间+错误级别，精准排查 journalctl -u nginx --since "1 hour ago" -p err</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-VZHBfG7L6dNZyvc3HhbckEUFnzf highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-B6lefy0Wed8Jd2cNRorcUiNFnGe">4. 按开机批次筛选日志</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JJH1fBwTGdHMMNcBsHXcrOK8nVe">服务器重启后，旧日志不会丢失，可通过开机批次回溯历史启动日志，专治<strong>开机启动失败、重启报错</strong>问题。</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-Hf4NfIFWtdkJ2OcPqdLcDXlSnte highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 查看所有开机记录 journalctl --list-boots # 查看本次开机以来的所有日志 journalctl -b # 查看上一次开机的日志（排查重启前的报错） journalctl -b -1 # 查看两次开机前的日志 journalctl -b -2</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-Hf4NfIFWtdkJ2OcPqdLcDXlSnte highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-DGEpfHCc9dkSSMcaWIKcBCg8n6d">5. 高级筛选：按进程、用户、内核</h3>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-DvbIfHX9gdL73qcv8C2cfNwTnFe highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 查看内核日志（等价于 dmesg） journalctl -k # 查看 root 用户（UID=0）的所有日志 journalctl _UID=0 --since today # 查看指定进程的日志 journalctl _PID=1234</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-DvbIfHX9gdL73qcv8C2cfNwTnFe highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-RPTlfGmUVdoGYGcEmcEc7hWenKv">四、实用输出格式优化</h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Peh0fVWnRdmB9Bc57LVcjPZ6nIb">默认日志格式冗长，可自定义输出格式，适配不同排查场景：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-IiYPfcNl2dKVCmc3Wzhcht7xn2g highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 简洁模式：只输出日志内容，隐藏多余元数据 journalctl -u nginx -o cat # JSON 格式输出（适合程序解析、日志对接） journalctl -u nginx -o json-pretty # 完整详细格式（排查疑难杂症用） journalctl -o verbose</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-IiYPfcNl2dKVCmc3Wzhcht7xn2g highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-SGsGfoeqVdWsxkc63ssc9jqTnuc">五、日志导出与清理（生产关键）</h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-D60CfyEA3dKIWacwVVfchtyEnah">1. 导出日志备份</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KbWgfIofNdNx8YcuXOZcxYVwn1d">排查问题后可导出指定日志，用于留存、复盘、上报：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-UQ5HffCrHdGWkFcuyW5ckwQsn3c highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 导出今日 Nginx 错误日志到文件 journalctl -u nginx --since today -p err &gt; nginx-error.log</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-UQ5HffCrHdGWkFcuyW5ckwQsn3c highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-RmHQfFSiZdpRzVcUiyIcF6uAn4g">2. 手动清理旧日志（避免磁盘爆满）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GYfHfksi0dFgqcc3NPVcvzLTnNh">journalctl 日志默认持续累积，长期不清理会占用大量磁盘空间，生产环境必须定期维护：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-VsU5fiRHgdHuPFcy03acCNUrnPh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 只保留最近 100M 日志 journalctl --vacuum-size=100M # 只保留最近 1 个月日志 journalctl --vacuum-time=1month # 只保留最近 7 天日志 journalctl --vacuum-time=7d</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-VsU5fiRHgdHuPFcy03acCNUrnPh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-N0jgfzTm4d79AKcfbcScG5Tanwg">3. 永久配置日志大小限制（推荐）</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Nro1fNv7edevdOc4oH9ctJNdnmf">修改配置文件，永久限制日志最大占用空间，自动清理过期日志：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-E5eQfbraVdV2UFcEoVpcsIBGnbh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 编辑配置文件 vim /etc/systemd/journald.conf # 修改以下参数 SystemMaxUse=500M # 日志最大占用500M SystemMaxFileSize=100M # 重启服务生效 systemctl restart systemd-journald</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-E5eQfbraVdV2UFcEoVpcsIBGnbh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-PvidflacldEONMcIx5scwup0nbb">六、生产高频排查场景（直接复制即用）</h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-EfZEfBLpKdKL8ccAylyc9A3Gnmb">整理运维日常最常用的组合命令，直接适配各类故障排查场景：</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-Kbvpfw4y1d7WrdcXARncaNMjnBh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<div># 1. 实时监控 SSH 登录报错 journalctl -u sshd -f -p err # 2. 排查 Nginx 最近1小时所有错误日志 journalctl -u nginx --since "1 hour ago" -p err -r # 3. 查看服务器上次开机的启动报错 journalctl -b -1 -p err # 4. 查看今日系统所有严重错误 journalctl --since today -p crit # 5. 实时监控自定义服务日志 journalctl -u myserver.service -f</div>
<pre class="ace-line old-record-id-Kbvpfw4y1d7WrdcXARncaNMjnBh highlighter-hljs">&nbsp;</pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-TFWDf6QL8d7ZNLcWcuBc8Q4rnIg">七、常见踩坑与注意事项</h2>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MgwSfZyEIdS0UWcr8c1cblHBnkb" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>权限问题</strong>：普通用户执行部分筛选命令可能无结果，排查系统日志建议加 <code>sudo</code></div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Shi9fiypEdp4tncaEJ7cDhmdnUf" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>日志丢失问题</strong>：部分极简系统默认关闭持久化日志，重启后日志清空。开启方式：修改 <code>/etc/systemd/journald.conf</code>，设置 <code>Storage=persistent</code></div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LIPifeC7DdDPTJcztG6cF0yOnje" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>分页卡顿</strong>：日志量过大时，加 <code>--no-pager</code> 直接一次性输出，避免分页卡顿</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-YAPQfu1kidk67lc8xoCctY2Unf4" data-list="bullet">
<div><strong>区分大小写</strong>：服务名必须准确，如 <code>sshd.service</code> 不能写成 ssh.service</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-RgqYfS9TIdK5uPcFeekcN4ajnGQ">八、命令速查表（收藏备用）</h2>

<td colspan="1" rowspan="1">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HviZfVlUVdQDoTc5OiScnuVtnKc">查看本次开机日志</div>

<tr>
<td colspan="1" rowspan="1">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QtaefbyuPdgpI9cd7ZycYLVRnL6">journalctl --since "1 hour ago"</div>
</td>
<td colspan="1" rowspan="1">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SS7mfOxyWdbvrVcUqC2cVgg9nrd">筛选指定时间范围日志</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="1" rowspan="1">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BIedfh7dgdQlF9cEB9VcLeH8nYg">journalctl --vacuum-size=100M</div>
</td>
<td colspan="1" rowspan="1">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GwAIfxjSMdUsZFcU1oecRu10n2e">清理旧日志，保留指定大小</div>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-BZwZf43Eld9sZocES5EcVBATnDh">总结</h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CumwfoPtvdJX6IckVu8cc49xnfe"><code>journalctl</code> 是现代 Linux 系统的日志核心工具，相比传统文本日志，具备<strong>统一、精准、高效、可回溯</strong>的优势。掌握这套用法，可覆盖 99% 的服务器日志排查场景，彻底告别挨个找日志文件、疯狂 grep 的低效操作。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Yx5ffekK8d6rhccYHwfcqRcwnGc">日常排查优先记住核心组合：<strong>服务筛选 + 时间范围 + 错误级别 + 实时监控</strong>，足够应对所有生产故障。</div>
</div>

</div>
